structured_output.what_is_happening: PUMPAGENT ("Pump Agent") is a 37-minute-old pump.fun token still on its bonding curve. It pumped about 160–215% in its first hour to an all-time high of about $24k market cap, then fell about 45–50% in the last 5 minutes to about $11.4k. It met the trigger because 5-minute volume spiked, and that spike was mostly the sell-off: GeckoTerminal shows 9 unique buyers against 27 sellers in the last 5 minutes. GMGN tags 46 of 82 holders as bundler wallets and 46 as fresh wallets. The project's website (pumpagent.space) is a bare landing page that calls itself "fan-made · not affiliated with pump.fun" and gives no product details. Web searches found no organic discussion of the contract, the ticker or the X handle.

narrative.description: A generic riff on pump.fun's real 'Tokenized Agents' and PumpAgent SDK features. The website openly says it is fan-made and unaffiliated. There is no specific event or catalyst behind it.
narrative.why_spreading: Nothing is visibly spreading. The price action looks like a bundled launch pump followed by an exit, not attention coming in from outside.

token_connection.why_this_token: It borrows the name of pump.fun's official agent/SDK work, but it is unofficial by its own admission and no one is referencing this contract.
token_connection.competing_tokens: An established 'Pump Agents' (PUMPAGENTS) token trades at about $2.7M on DexScreener, and there is a separate pumpagent.gg site. Pump.fun's own tokenized-agent features are the real concept.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN: 46 bundler wallets and 46 fresh wallets among 82 holders, 29% of trading from top bundlers, bot/degen rate 0.47. The dev has only 1 launched token, and no discussion was found anywhere. The fast pump to $24k and immediate halving fit a bundled launch followed by a dump.
